company.name: Slangit Technologies
company.shortDescription: Slangit Technologies is an AI infrastructure and knowledge management company, develops multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
company.description: Slangit Technologies is a Dubai-based artificial intelligence and enterprise software company focused on advanced knowledge retrieval, multilingual AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) infrastructure. Founded in 2023, the company develops AI-powered platforms that convert enterprise documents, databases, manuals, and operational data into interactive and intelligent knowledge systems accessible through voice and text interfaces. The company’s core technology, known as “1Engine,” powers multiple AI-driven products including Knowledge Base as a Service (KBaaS), Intelligent Learning Management Systems (iLMS), and enterprise evaluation platforms. Slangit focuses heavily on Arabic NLP and multilingual AI capabilities, enabling organizations across the MENA region to deploy AI systems that understand Arabic dialects and localized business contexts with higher accuracy.
